summaries.n-lightberry-lumi-coins: Coins named LUMI after Lightberry's Lumi humanoid robot. Lightberry's press release of 2026-10-30 says the Lumi line received Conditional Approval from the U.S. Department of War and, on that basis, an exemption from the FCC Covered List (Public Notice DA 26-1181), making it the first and so far only humanoid robot company approved; its X post of 2026-10-31 00:30 UTC announced it and a Y Combinator post and a robotics news account repeated it (e3:0, e3:1). LUMI (LUMI, Pump.fun, Solana, pool opened 2026-10-31 01:01 UTC) has an empty description. LUMI (LUMI, Pump.fun, 03:05 UTC): "LUMI ($LUMI) brings friendly robot charm, sunny yellow vibes, and playful meme energy to Solana." LUMI (LUMI, Meteora DBC, 06:26 UTC) has an empty description. All three opened after Lightberry's post. Traders' posts disagree about which LUMI contract is the real one, and several mention a DJT pairing (e2:1); Lightberry has named no token and none of the coins is shown to be connected to the company. The approval claims are Lightberry's own and the FCC notice was not checked here.
